user.title: Google Home Authentication
user.description:
Authenticate with the Google account that manages your Google Home / Nest speakers.

• **Method 1 (Recommended): Google App Password**
Enter your Google email and a 16-character App Password generated at [myaccount.google.com/apppasswords](https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). Leave Master Token blank.

• **Method 2: Token Authentication**
If password login fails or if Google requires browser verification, log into [accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup](https://accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup), copy the `oauth_token` cookie value (`oauth2_4/...`) from DevTools (F12 > Storage/Application > Cookies), and paste it into Master Token. Leave App Password blank.

*(Note: Standard Google passwords do not work if 2-Step Verification is enabled. Android device ID is generated automatically.)*

data_description.username: The full Google email address associated with your Google Home or Nest speakers.
data_description.password: A 16-character App Password generated from your Google Account security settings. Do NOT use your standard personal account password.
data_description.master_token: Optional. Paste an existing aas_et/... master token or an oauth2_4/... token extracted from accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Google authentication servers.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Use a 16-character App Password (myaccount.google.com/apppasswords). If Google blocks password login, log in at https://accounts.google.com/EmbeddedSetup, copy the 'oauth_token' cookie from DevTools (F12 > Storage/Application > Cookies), and paste it into Master Token.

data_description.selected_speaker: Select 'Global Settings' to apply defaults to all speakers, or select a specific speaker to customize its behavior.
data_description.orchestration_mode: round_robin staggers scans across speakers to prevent 2.4GHz Wi-Fi congestion; independent runs each speaker on its own schedule.
data_description.playback_mode: throttle reduces scan frequency while music plays; skip_ceiling pauses scanning completely up to a time limit; ignore continues normal scanning.
data_description.scan_timeout: How many seconds each Bluetooth inquiry scan runs when the speaker is idle (default: 5).
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds to wait between scans when the speaker is idle (default: 10).
data_description.playing_scan_timeout: Scan duration in seconds while media is actively streaming (default: 3).
data_description.playing_scan_interval: Seconds to wait between scans while media is actively streaming (default: 45).
data_description.max_playing_skip_duration: Maximum continuous seconds scanning may be delayed during long media playback sessions before forcing a scan (default: 180).
data_description.rssi_threshold: Ignore advertisements weaker than this dBm cutoff (default: -90 dBm).
data_description.rssi_offset: Hardware calibration offset added to raw RSSI measurements (e.g. +2 for Home Mini, 0 for Nest Mini).
data_description.filter_mode: all forwards all advertisements; known_only forwards named or IRK-resolved devices; whitelist restricts to specified devices.
data_description.tracked_devices: Comma-separated MAC prefixes (e.g. AA:BB:CC) or device names to track when whitelist mode is selected.
data_description.enable_rssi_smoothing: Apply a rolling filter to smooth out erratic signal spikes from physical interference.
data_description.rssi_filter_mode: Algorithm used for signal smoothing: median (effective against outliers) or ema (exponential moving average).
data_description.rssi_filter_window: Number of recent advertisement samples retained in the rolling filter window (default: 3).
data_description.enable_distance_estimation: Estimate physical distance in meters using the log-distance path loss model.
data_description.max_distance: Drop advertisements estimated beyond this distance in meters to avoid cross-room bleeds (0.0 disables cutoff).
data_description.ref_power: Expected RSSI at 1 meter distance in your environment (default: -59 dBm).
data_description.path_loss_exponent: Signal path loss absorption factor for indoor RF propagation (indoor default: 2.5).
data_description.known_irks: Identity Resolving Keys used to resolve private rotating MAC addresses for Apple devices. Format: DeviceName:32HexChars, one per line.
